name: retrieval-agent-harness-pi
description: Project-local Pi extension dependencies. meta-harness is a co-located development file: dependency consumed through its built dist/ (see ../docs/meta-operator-design.md for the versioned-package boundary). At runtime Pi's extension loader aliases @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @earendil-works/pi-ai, and typebox to the installed host instances; the exact-version devDependencies here exist only for the strict typecheck and for running the extension module under plain node in tests.
